applicability: If the sole standalone diagnostic passes, use this comparison for STANDALONE_PASS_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE. Historical bounds also apply if standalone fails.
source_hash_comparison_method: Read the original historical source_bindings in both immutable preoperational gate records and compare each with SHA256 of current source bytes; historical hashes were not updated.

context_comparison.blocked_nested: Same frozen provider installs the same observer during runtime.verify().
context_comparison.standalone: No PINNED.1C owner or provider observer is required; the diagnostic observation mechanism is separately recorded by the diagnostic runner.
context_comparison.conclusion: Profiler presence alone does not explain why the nested attempt failed because the successful retry also had this profiler.

context_comparison.successful_retry: PrivateConfigObserver installs sys.settrace and observes only the exact frozen Docker prefix/control code objects; the provider profiler operates inside it.
context_comparison.blocked_nested: SYNTH replay script does not install PrivateConfigObserver or another tracer.
context_comparison.conclusion: A measured difference in replay instrumentation exists. No causal effect is established.
The global temporary root determines random absent Docker config paths and phase workspace location. Historical roots differ, but the report does not establish a path failure.

context_comparison.successful_retry: PINNED.1B and BIND temporarily wrap baseline transport, and PINNED.1B also wraps SANDBOX replay before JAVA.1C.
context_comparison.blocked_nested: The same frozen scoped wrappers precede JAVA.1C.
context_comparison.conclusion: patch.object scopes finish before JAVA.1C. Static source provides no evidence of residual wrappers. Historical runtime function identities were not separately retained, so absence of residue cannot be retrospectively measured.

context_comparison.historical_blocked_upstream_cleanup: bind_cleanup_verified, bind_sandbox_cleanup_verified and inspection_cleanup_verified are true; both upstream remaining container counts are zero.
context_comparison.conclusion: Frozen target owner joins export threads and closes pipes before issuing successful evidence. The records do not implicate live export threads during JAVA.1C.

SANDBOX.2/JAVA.1C use independent module-local HMAC secrets. They expose no issuing PID or live registry and have no exact-object membership check. Earlier PINNED graph work populates provider registries, but frozen SANDBOX/JAVA validators do not consume those registries. No secret or signature is disclosed.

Nested SYNTH adds imports and caller frames around the provider graph. Provider observation traverses frames only to classify effect accounting. No frozen SANDBOX/JAVA semantic predicate depends directly on SYNTH caller identity.

historical_blocked_effect_bound.bounded_inference: The JAVA.1C SANDBOX replay failed before any ladder invocation. Potential frozen pre-ladder paths include image metadata parse/eligibility or temporary directory, policy/sentinel file and socket setup. A particular deeper failure cannot be recovered from the frozen report.

hmac_distinction.historical_error_implies: The public sandbox descriptor validator and policy validator returned before java1c_live_sandbox2_binding_rejected was raised by the semantic branch.

observation_constraints.capture_consumed_pair: Capture authenticate_sandbox2 call arguments or the _evidence_pair return whose caller is _obtain_live_sandbox2. SANDBOX replay signs an earlier pair, while JAVA.1C builds a second pair consumed by its gate.

limitations: No second live issuance was performed for comparison.
Historical SANDBOX replay report and consumed object identities are absent from the blocked JAVA.1C report.
Historical instrumentation and runtime function identities were not independently recorded.
Matching source bytes do not prove equal process-global state or equal Docker responses at different times.
Static context differences identify possible dependencies; none is a demonstrated cause.
A passing standalone diagnostic establishes reproducibility in that process and context, and does not prove the historical nested failure was caused by nesting.
